# Pull Request Template

## Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the changes introduced by this pull request. Explain the rationale behind these changes and how they improve the codebase.

## Related Issues
List any related issues linked to this pull request (e.g., `Fixes #12` or `Closes #45`).

## Type of Change
Please check the option(s) that apply:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (only modifications to markdown or inline documentation)
- [ ] Performance optimization (enhancements to training speed, VRAM usage, or decoding)

## How Has This Been Tested?
Describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Provide details of your testing environment (e.g., local GPU, Colab, Kaggle Dual-T4) and model checkpoints tested.

## Checklist
By submitting this pull request, you confirm that:
- [ ] My code follows the PEP 8 coding style guidelines for this project.
- My commits and pull request description contain no emojis.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or runtime exceptions.
- [ ] I have verified that training can start and resume successfully with my changes.
